# HTML&HTML

> HTML&HTML is a bilingual 12-engine website diagnosis and implementation-mandate platform. Evidence-backed public findings are free; the implementation contract is the paid product.

HTML&HTML separates measured facts, official standards, vendor guidance, proposals, internal heuristics and experimental agent surfaces. Public scanning never invents source-file paths and never fabricates field Core Web Vitals.

## Core product

- [Machine-readable product overview](https://htmlandhtml.com/index.md): Clean Markdown overview of the free diagnosis, twelve analysis engines, evidence boundary and USD 149 implementation mandate.
- [Engineering guide](https://htmlandhtml.com/guide.md): llms.txt v2 structure, path-specific discovery, AI crawler role separation, evidence classes and release gates.
- [Methodology and evidence policy](https://htmlandhtml.com/about.md): How HTML&HTML distinguishes measured evidence, standards, vendor policies, proposals, heuristics and deliberate non-claims.
- [API contract](https://htmlandhtml.com/api.md): Machine-readable documentation for the full scan, formal llms.txt audit, health and paid mandate endpoints.

## Important interpretation notes

- 100/100 means only that measured checks passed. It does not guarantee rankings, traffic, sales or AI citations.
- llms.txt v2 is a proposal. HTML&HTML does not treat its absence as a Google Search ranking failure.
- Public scanning verifies externally visible behavior but cannot reliably name the source file that must change. File-level targeting requires source/codebase context.
- Reliable field LCP, INP and CLS require appropriate field/lab evidence. If unavailable, those metrics remain NOT_MEASURED.
- Search/retrieval crawler controls are evaluated separately from model-training or product-control tokens.

## Optional

- [llms.txt v2 proposal](https://llmstxt.org/): Upstream proposal used by the versioned formal llms.txt rule set.
